name: Yakeppachi Sekai Seifuku
source:
The hero, an archer and I have departed on a journey to defeat the demon king. At some point, I realized I'm so in love with the hero my heart just won't stop pounding! I don't even care about defeating the demon king anymore!

I gathered my courage and told him how I felt, but...

"I love you too. Like a little sister."

...wait, what? Little sister? Are you kidding me?!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20629]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我与勇者、弓箭手一同踏上了讨伐魔王的旅途。不知不觉间，我发现自己已经深深爱上了勇者，心儿怦怦直跳个不停！如今就连打倒魔王什么的也全都无所谓了！

我鼓起勇气向他倾诉了自己的心意，然而……

“我也喜欢你哦。把你当妹妹一样喜欢。”

……等一下，什么？妹妹？开什么玩笑啊？！

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20629]Freem![/url]]
